package.name: lightsfm
package.description:
Header-only Social Force Model library (Helbing/Molnar with Moussaid social term), forked from robotics-upo/lightsfm.
Arena packages this as an ament CMake package so the headers are a normal source dependency under src/deps/. Upstream ships only a Makefile whose `install` target copies the headers into /usr/local/include/lightsfm -- that path is baked into the arena container image and is not a bind mount, so edits there were silently reverted by `docker compose --force-recreate` and had to be replayed by hand. Building from source removes that failure mode: edit include/sfm.hpp, rebuild hunav_agent_manager, done.
